intro.heading:
Hi, I´m Johanna!
Nice to see you here.
intro.text:
I am a **participatory researcher and collaborative designer** with a background in communication and social sciences. I use design as a means to **explore and engage with social, cultural and ecological challenges**.

First, I design context-specific methods that make complex issues tangible, and bring various perspectives and stakeholders together to facilitate dialogue, reflection and learning. Second, I translate insights into clear actionable outcomes that support evidence-informed decision-making and possible pathways forward.

I have applied this research approach in various international and interdisciplinary projects in Germany, Finland, Mexico, South Korea, India and Ghana, where I worked with universities, researchers, NGOs, public-sector organizations, and community partners.

entries.title: Co-founder · ÜBERmorgen – Spiel um die Zukunft
entries.details:
- Co-developed ÜBERmorgen – Spiel um die Zukunft, an educational board game that enables dialogue future scenarios.
- Co-managed the project from concept to production, including game design, playtesting, balancing mechanics, visual development, crowdfunding campaign (€7k), manufacturing coordination and strategic partnerships.
- Implemented an impact-oriented distribution model by donating 300+ games to public institutions across Germany and engaging diverse audiences through conferences, festivals, and 15+ workshops.

entries.title: Innovation & Strategy · Central Services, Solutions Team (Intern)
entries.details:
- Conducted interviews, usability testing, and stakeholder workshops to identify user needs and translate insights into digital product requirements for internal and external projects.
- Designed user journeys, information architectures, and interactive prototypes for web and desktop applications, including a public-sector digital sports facility atlas, a tax assessment platform, and an employee management application.
- Researched emerging applications of AI and LLMs in UX/UI design and facilitated 12 workshops at KPMG's Prototyping Lab.

entries.title: Product Experience · Business Services Team (Working Student)
entries.details:
- Conducted user, product, and business research to inform PwC´s digital product experience strategy and improve service delivery.
- Designed UI/UX concepts, user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes using design systems for user-centered digital solutions, including PwC's Digital Store, an internal employee platform, an AI-powered knowledge management tool, and a public-sector digital platform supporting high-volume administrative processes.
